adopt: Watch systemd unit transitions, container image digest diffs and bootc atomic status, coalesce restarts from updates, and emit Ed25519-signed, optionally AES-256-GCM encrypted alerts with a verifiable audit log.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Services restart, containers roll onto new digests, and atomic OS images stage and boot silently. By the time someone notices a restart loop or failed unit, the journal context is gone, and plain webhook posts carry no proof of who emitted them or whether they were tampered with in transit.

Install
not on PyPI yet (pending publish); builds in-tree
synopsis: Tamper-evident, Ed25519-signed and AES-256-GCM encrypted lifecycle alerts for services, container updates and atomic OS transitions.
